name: DEAR U Co., LTD.
summary: DEAR U Co., LTD. operates as a communication platform company in South Korea and internationally. The company offers everysing, a smart karaoke; Lysn, an interest-based community that enables its members to talk about their favorite music artists with their friends; and bubble, an app that allows to share messages back and forth with artists and fans. DEAR U Co., LTD. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
